description: Track the selected Explore searches in Monitor, each under its Explore Topic, on the chosen platforms and cadence, using the planFingerprint from the activation preview. Reuses matching tracked searches and moves them to the chosen cadence; a paused one must be reviewed first. Setup is free; the first scheduled refresh starts on the next scheduler pass and each refresh is charged when it collects. Returns status, Topic ids and tracking item ids; collected results are available later. Requires an explicit workspace and idempotencyKey; supply confirmedScopeFingerprint only after the preview required confirmation (an unusually large scope, or a scheduled search moving to another cadence).

body.description: Optional complete canonical activateSearches body; explicit fields override it.

cadence.description: Refresh cadence; defaults to weekly. Each refresh is charged when it collects.

confirmedScopeFingerprint.description: Required only when the activation preview returned confirmationRequired; echo the reviewed planFingerprint once after the principal confirms the aggregate scope, reusing the same idempotencyKey.

sourcePlatforms.description: Platforms to track the selected searches on, for example ["tiktok"].

topicName.description: Topic for selected searches Explore left ungrouped; every other search is tracked under its Explore Topic. Omitted, up to three ungrouped searches each get a Topic named after themselves and more share one named after the Explore (the preview's ungroupedTopicName). An existing Topic with the same name is reused.

name: socialseal_explore_activate_searches
title: Activate Explore searches
